description:
In today’s vlog, we explore some truly unbelievable places in Sylhet including Lalakhal and Dibir Haor, each reflecting the natural charm of Bangladesh. We also stayed at and reviewed a small, beautiful resort in Sylhet city, shared our journey from Dhaka to Sylhet, and explored Sylhet’s local food. Hope you enjoy the full vlog 💕
